news.title: Jalen Green scores 25 and Devin Booker adds 22 to help the Suns top the Pelicans 123-119 in OT
news.text: — Jalen Green scored 25 points, Devin Booker added 22, and the Phoenix Suns defeated the New Orleans Pelicans, 123-119 in overtime on Monday night.

news.title: Devin Booker scores 23 points and Suns pull away in final minute for 111-101 win over Jazz
news.text: — Devin Booker had 23 points and the Phoenix Suns scored the final six of the game to pull away late and beat the Utah Jazz 111-101 in an NBA Cup matchup Friday night.

news.text: — Jordan Goodwin scored 18 points in his return from a calf injury, Devin Booker added 17 and the Phoenix Suns cruised past the Los Angeles Clippers 133-110 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Wembanyama has 40 points, 9 blocks as Spurs win 9th straight with 122-96 victory over Suns
news.text: — Victor Wembanyama scored 40 points, grabbed 11 rebounds and blocked nine shots in another dominant performance to help the San Antonio Spurs beat the Phoenix Suns 122-96 on Monday night.

news.title: Booker scores 24, Suns outlast Rockets 102-99 for 1st back-to-back wins of season
news.text: — Devin Booker scored 24 points, including seven straight to break a late tie, and the Phoenix Suns held off the Houston Rockets 102-99 on Saturday night.
